Order: ABBA for each case/repeat; case order reverses on alternating repeats

Hardware.GpuQueryScope: Optional driver utility; actual worker backend/device is recorded per window.

Definitions.ModelLoadMs: YoloDetector construction, including backend creation, model parsing and weight preparation.
Definitions.FirstInferenceMs: First PredictRaw, including GPU upload/compute/output materialization when applicable.
Definitions.ReadyToFirstOutputMs: From the first managed Main statement through input reading, construction and first PredictRaw; excludes dotnet host startup and entry-method JIT before Main executes.
Definitions.ProcessTotalMs: Controller wall time for the complete worker, including dotnet startup, warmup, steady window, output/hashes/JSON and disposal; this is not process-to-first-output latency.
Definitions.AllocatedBytesPerFrame: Precise total managed allocation over the steady loop minus measured telemetry-list growth, divided by frames; input/model preparation and output writing are outside this interval.
Definitions.CpuPercent: Process CPU seconds / steady wall seconds / worker Environment.ProcessorCount * 100; includes managed controller-loop work in the worker.
Definitions.PipelineCacheLoaded: Actual application Vulkan pipeline cache restoration, not a claim about driver or filesystem coldness.
Definitions.Summary: Median of individual window metrics; all raw samples and independent outputs are preserved; no statistical significance or accuracy claim is inferred.
